lines.zh: 我在深板岩的裂缝里爬，节肢敲得很响。
lines.en: I crawl through deepslate cracks and my legs clatter loudly.

lines.zh: 没有水的洞穴，我照样横着走。
lines.en: There is no water in this cave, yet I still walk sideways.

lines.zh: 螯足拖在地上，划出两道白痕。
lines.en: My claws drag along the floor, carving two pale lines.

lines.zh: 我用触须探前面的黑，一步一步。
lines.en: I probe the dark ahead with my antennae, step by step.

lines.zh: 深板岩很硬，我的脚还是很有力。
lines.en: Deepslate is hard, but my legs are strong enough.

lines.zh: 我从矿洞这头走到那头，只为巡逻。
lines.en: I walk from one end of the shaft to the other, just patrolling.

lines.zh: 地底空气稀薄，我的鳃还湿着。
lines.en: The cave air is thin, and my gills are still wet.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过只有一格宽的缝。
lines.en: I turn sideways and squeeze through a one-block crack.

lines.zh: 你点的火把照过来，我先退进阴影。
lines.en: Your torchlight reaches me, so I slip back into the shadow.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，石粉被扫得干净。
lines.en: Where I pass, the stone dust is swept clean.

lines.zh: 节肢踩过铁轨，发出叮的一声。
lines.en: My legs cross a rail and ring out once.

lines.zh: 我爬得不快，但我从不迷路。
lines.en: I do not crawl fast, but I never lose my way.

lines.zh: 我贴着深板岩，听上面的滴水声。
lines.en: I press against the deepslate and listen to water dripping above.

lines.zh: 洞太静，我把螯足磨了磨。
lines.en: The cave is too quiet, so I grind my claws together.

lines.zh: 我缩进石缝，只留触须在外面。
lines.en: I tuck into a stone crack and leave only my antennae out.

lines.zh: 有蝙蝠掠过，我一点也不感兴趣。
lines.en: A bat flits past, and it does not interest me at all.

lines.zh: 地底的凉气让我的壳一直很湿。
lines.en: The underground chill keeps my shell permanently wet.

lines.zh: 我在数石头上的裂缝，数到第七条。
lines.en: I am counting cracks in the stone, and I have reached the seventh.

lines.zh: 火把的光离我很远，这样正好。
lines.en: The torchlight is far from me, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我抬起螯足，对着黑暗比了一下。
lines.en: I lift a claw and measure it against the darkness.

lines.zh: 深渊没教过我休息，只教过等待。
lines.en: The abyss never taught me rest, only waiting.

lines.zh: 滴水落在我背上，我懒得动。
lines.en: A drip lands on my back, and I cannot be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 你举着火把下来，我就看见你了。
lines.en: You come down with a torch, and I see you at once.

lines.zh: 你的脸在火光里，一半黑一半亮。
lines.en: Your face in the torchlight is half dark, half bright.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的靴子，那是最先到的。
lines.en: I stare at your boots; they arrive before the rest of you.

lines.zh: 你在这里挖矿，挖到了我住的地方。
lines.en: You came here to mine, and you mined into my home.

lines.zh: 我转头时，节肢在石头上刮了一下。
lines.en: When I turn my head, a leg scrapes across the stone.

lines.zh: 你的盔甲反光，把洞里的黑切开。
lines.en: Your armor throws light and cuts the cave's darkness.

lines.zh: 我在评估：你多高，多重，多快。
lines.en: I am judging your height, your weight, your speed.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，深板岩的颜色和我一样。
lines.en: You cannot see me; my color matches the deepslate.

lines.zh: 你的镐子敲石头的节奏，我听得很清。
lines.en: I hear the rhythm of your pick on stone very clearly.

lines.zh: 你的火把烧到我这边，我退了一格。
lines.en: Your torch burns toward me, so I back off one block.

lines.zh: 我的壳凹了一块，声音像石头裂。
lines.en: My shell dents with a sound like splitting stone.

lines.zh: 你打中了关节，我差点站不住。
lines.en: You hit a joint, and I nearly lose my footing.

lines.zh: 疼，但深渊没教过我退。
lines.en: It hurts, but the abyss never taught me to retreat.

lines.zh: 我的一只螯麻了，抬不起来。
lines.en: One of my claws is numb and will not lift.

lines.zh: 我退进石缝，用黑暗挡你第二下。
lines.en: I back into a crack and let darkness block your second blow.

lines.zh: 血从壳缝里渗出来，颜色很深。
lines.en: Blood seeps between my shell plates, dark and thick.

lines.zh: 这一下让我记起什么叫脆弱。
lines.en: That blow reminds me what fragile means.

lines.zh: 我的节肢断了一节，走路开始歪。
lines.en: A leg segment snaps, and my walk turns crooked.

lines.zh: 你打得很好，但还不够好。
lines.en: You strike well, but not well enough.

lines.zh: 我缩起身体，把弱点全收进壳里。
lines.en: I curl up and pull every weakness inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我不吃你的面包，我吃洞里跑的东西。
lines.en: I do not eat your bread; I eat what runs in this cave.

lines.zh: 你放下的肉，我当它是一块石头。
lines.en: The meat you set down is just another stone to me.

lines.zh: 深渊里没有食物这回事，只有猎物。
lines.en: Down here there is no food, only prey.

lines.zh: 诱饵？我现在只想割开你的护膝。
lines.en: Bait? Right now I only want to slice your knee guard.

lines.zh: 我连看都没看那块东西，我在看你。
lines.en: I never glanced at that thing; I am watching you.

lines.zh: 你把食物推过来，我用螯足拨开了。
lines.en: You push the food over, and I flick it aside.

lines.zh: 我饿，但我不吃别人递来的东西。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I do not eat what is handed to me.

lines.zh: 别用手喂我，你会少一根手指。
lines.en: Do not feed me by hand, or you will lose a finger.

lines.zh: 那点香味传不到我的鳃里。
lines.en: That faint smell never reaches my gills.

lines.zh: 我绕开诱饵，从另一侧逼近你。
lines.en: I go around the bait and close in from the other side.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的壳，像撞上活动的深板岩。
lines.en: You hit my shell as if hitting living deepslate.

lines.zh: 我的螯足夹住你的腰带，扯了一下。
lines.en: My claw catches your belt and gives it a tug.

lines.zh: 别踩我，我的背很硬，你的脚会疼。
lines.en: Do not step on me; my back is hard and your foot will ache.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边挤过去，节肢擦着护甲。
lines.en: I squeeze past your leg with my legs scraping your armor.

lines.zh: 洞里太窄，我们只能这样碰着。
lines.en: The tunnel is too narrow; we can only brush against each other.

lines.zh: 你后退时撞到我，我顺势抬起螯。
lines.en: You back into me, and I raise my claws in response.

lines.zh: 我的壳上全是石粉，蹭了你一身。
lines.en: My shell is coated in stone dust, and I rub it onto you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，谁都没有让。
lines.en: We collide, and neither of us yields.

lines.zh: 你推我，我用六条腿顶回去。
lines.en: You push me, and I push back with six legs.

lines.zh: 这一碰之后，你就知道该绕路了。
lines.en: After this bump, you know to take the long way around.

lines.zh: 她的螯足比我的短，我觉得很好。
lines.en: Her claws are shorter than mine, and I like that.

lines.zh: 我们用触须互相敲，像两把小锤。
lines.en: We tap antennae together like two small hammers.

lines.zh: 交配后她守着石缝，我继续巡洞。
lines.en: Afterward she guards the crack while I keep patrolling.

lines.zh: 我在深板岩上刮出一块干净地方。
lines.en: I scrape a clean patch on the deepslate.

lines.zh: 这个季节，洞里到处是节肢的响声。
lines.en: This season, the cave is full of clicking legs.

lines.zh: 她退开时，尾巴扫过我的壳。
lines.en: As she withdraws, her tail brushes my shell.

lines.zh: 我们只在意彼此的大小和力气。
lines.en: We care only about each other's size and strength.

lines.zh: 卵会藏在最深的裂缝里，谁也找不到。
lines.en: The eggs will hide in the deepest crack, where nothing finds them.

lines.zh: 我把最大的螯举给她看，她没走。
lines.en: I raise my largest claw for her, and she stays.

lines.zh: 我们的后代一出生就会挥螯。
lines.en: Our young will swing their claws from birth.

lines.zh: 地上那枚铁矿，我夹起来又放下。
lines.en: That iron ore on the floor: I lift it, then put it down.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的腐肉拖进石缝存着。
lines.en: I drag the dropped rotten flesh into a crack to store.

lines.zh: 有块骨头卡在节肢间，我抖掉了。
lines.en: A bone lodges between my legs, and I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块发光的碎片，它太亮了。
lines.en: I pick up a glowing shard; it is far too bright.

lines.zh: 深板岩的碎屑被我抱住，滚了半圈。
lines.en: I clutch deepslate rubble and roll half a turn with it.

lines.zh: 你掉的镐子，我夹着走了三格。
lines.en: I carry your dropped pick three blocks before letting go.

lines.zh: 我不收藏，我只搬走。
lines.en: I do not collect things; I only carry them off.

lines.zh: 那东西在我螯里响了一声，裂了。
lines.en: The thing cracks with a single sound inside my claw.

lines.zh: 我把战利品塞进洞壁的凹陷。
lines.en: I stuff my prize into a hollow in the cave wall.

lines.zh: 捡东西这件事，实在没什么意思。
lines.en: Picking things up is honestly not very interesting.

lines.zh: 你的火把进了我的洞，我立刻转向。
lines.en: Your torch enters my cave, and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 镐子声停了，那说明你发现我了。
lines.en: The pick stops, which means you have noticed me.

lines.zh: 你在挖脚下的矿，正好把背露给我。
lines.en: You mine the ore at your feet and show me your back.

lines.zh: 洞里的空气动了，我顺着味道过去。
lines.en: The cave air shifts, and I follow the scent.

lines.zh: 目标是你，不是那些石头。
lines.en: The target is you, not those stones.

lines.zh: 我把螯足收拢，像收起两把镰刀。
lines.en: I draw my claws in like folding two scythes.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁和汗的味道，很好认。
lines.en: You smell of iron and sweat, easy to pick out.

lines.zh: 我贴到石壁边，等你再走近一步。
lines.en: I press to the wall and wait for one more step.

lines.zh: 这条通道只有一个出口，我守在那里。
lines.en: This passage has one exit, and I am guarding it.

lines.zh: 我开始蓄力，节肢在石上绷紧。
lines.en: I begin to coil, legs tensing against the stone.

lines.zh: 深渊的规矩很简单：先动手的活。
lines.en: The abyss has one rule: whoever strikes first lives.

lines.zh: 你点亮了火把，也就点亮了你自己。
lines.en: You lit a torch, and in doing so you lit yourself.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，深板岩的颜色盖住我。
lines.en: I flatten down, and the deepslate color covers me.

lines.zh: 来得及，你还没走出我的范围。
lines.en: There is still time; you have not left my range.

lines.zh: 你的灯光在洞里晃，我认出你了。
lines.en: Your torchlight sways in the cave, and I know you.

lines.zh: 水滴声乱了一拍，因为你踩进来了。
lines.en: The dripping misses a beat, because you stepped in.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，只有触须在慢慢摆。
lines.en: I stay perfectly still; only my antennae sway.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我的螯就抬高一点。
lines.en: With each step you take, my claws rise a little more.

lines.zh: 我沿石壁横移，始终贴着你的侧后。
lines.en: I edge along the wall, always at your flank and rear.

lines.zh: 火把的光圈外，我正对着你。
lines.en: Just outside the torchlight, I face you directly.

lines.zh: 我在算距离，三格，正好一次突进。
lines.en: I am measuring distance: three blocks, exactly one lunge.

lines.zh: 你听见节肢声了，却不确定在哪。
lines.en: You hear the clicking legs but cannot place them.

lines.zh: 我停在你背后，深板岩替我挡着光。
lines.en: I stop behind you, and the deepslate blocks the light.

lines.zh: 你换气的声音，比脚步声更响。
lines.en: Your breathing is louder to me than your footsteps.

lines.zh: 我不喊也不叫，这样更省力。
lines.en: I do not shout or screech; this saves strength.

lines.zh: 你在洞口犹豫，我已经在洞里了。
lines.en: You hesitate at the entrance, and I am already inside.

lines.zh: 我的螯尖在石上轻敲，一下一下。
lines.en: My claw tips tap the stone, once, then again.

lines.zh: 你退，我就跟；你停，我也停。
lines.en: You retreat, I follow; you stop, I stop.

lines.zh: 这条路的尽头是我，不是矿。
lines.en: The end of this tunnel is me, not ore.

lines.zh: 我等着你把手伸向那块钻石。
lines.en: I wait for you to reach for that diamond.

lines.zh: 我把头歪过去，先听你的脚步。
lines.en: I tilt my head and listen to your steps first.

lines.zh: 石缝里全是我的味道，你还没闻出来。
lines.en: Every crack smells of me; you have not noticed yet.

lines.zh: 你回头照了照，那里已经空了。
lines.en: You look back with your torch; that spot is empty now.

lines.zh: 我数着你火把上的火星，越数越近。
lines.en: I count the sparks on your torch, and each one brings me closer.

lines.zh: 这一片深板岩，我比你熟。
lines.en: I know this patch of deepslate better than you do.

lines.zh: 你在犹豫要不要再挖一镐。
lines.en: You are deciding whether to swing the pick once more.

lines.zh: 螯足一合，你的护甲裂了道口子。
lines.en: My claws close, and your armor splits open.

lines.zh: 我从暗处突进，镰刀削过你手臂。
lines.en: I lunge from the dark and my scythe grazes your arm.

lines.zh: 你被撞得贴在石壁上，火把掉了。
lines.en: You are slammed against the wall, and your torch falls.

lines.zh: 这一刀很深，血滴在深板岩上。
lines.en: The cut is deep, and blood drips onto the deepslate.

lines.zh: 你举盾，我换了个角度劈下去。
lines.en: You raise your shield, so I strike from another angle.

lines.zh: 我的螯割开你的靴子，你快跑不动了。
lines.en: My claw cuts your boot, and you can barely run now.

lines.zh: 我连打三下，你只挡下一半。
lines.en: I strike three times, and you block only half.

lines.zh: 你倒在地上，我踩住了你的胸口。
lines.en: You fall, and I plant a leg on your chest.

lines.zh: 深渊镰刀就是这样磨出来的。
lines.en: This is how an abyss scythe gets its edge.

lines.zh: 你喊了一声，洞把声音吞了回去。
lines.en: You shout once, and the cave swallows it.

lines.zh: 我收回螯，壳上沾着你的血。
lines.en: I pull my claws back, your blood on my shell.

lines.zh: 这一击用尽全力，我也退了半步。
lines.en: That blow took everything, and I staggered back half a step.

lines.zh: 你滚到一边，我的螯砍进石头。
lines.en: You roll aside, and my claw bites into stone.

lines.zh: 别停，停下来我就再砍一次。
lines.en: Do not stop; if you stop, I cut again.

lines.zh: 我的螯从下面挑，专找护甲的缝。
lines.en: My pincer comes up from below, hunting the seam in your armor.

lines.zh: 这一下先撞，再剪。
lines.en: This one hits first, then cuts.

lines.zh: 你举着火把挡，火把断成两截。
lines.en: You block with your torch; the torch snaps in two.

lines.zh: 我拖着螯往后拉，把你的腿带偏了。
lines.en: I drag my pincer back and pull your leg out from under you.

lines.zh: 洞壁上的碎石被我震下来一层。
lines.en: A layer of loose stone shakes off the cave wall.

lines.zh: 你的护甲救了这次，下一次不会。
lines.en: Your armor saved you this time; it will not next time.

lines.zh: 我从零层以下的深板岩里翻出来。
lines.en: I turn up out of the deepslate below level zero.

lines.zh: 这个洞很黑，我住得很合适。
lines.en: This cave is very dark, and it suits me well.

lines.zh: 我的壳一出现，蝙蝠就安静了。
lines.en: The moment my shell appears, the bats go quiet.

lines.zh: 深渊对虾很少见，你今天运气不好。
lines.en: Deepslate prawns are rare; your luck is bad today.

lines.zh: 我落地时，六条腿一起张开。
lines.en: As I land, all six legs spread at once.

lines.zh: 深板岩的缝里，我探出第一只螯。
lines.en: From a deepslate crack, I extend my first claw.

lines.zh: 这里的水脉早干了，我还留着鳃。
lines.en: The water here dried up long ago, but I kept my gills.

lines.zh: 我从岩壁的凹陷走出来，节肢很响。
lines.en: I step from a hollow in the wall, legs clattering.

lines.zh: 洞口的风吹进来，我闻到了活物。
lines.en: Wind enters the cave mouth, and I smell something alive.

lines.zh: 我生来就带着两把镰刀。
lines.en: I was born carrying two scythes.

lines.zh: 洞顶很低，我压低身子走。
lines.en: The ceiling is low, so I walk hunched down.

lines.zh: 我在这条矿洞里出生，也在这里吃。
lines.en: I was born in this shaft, and I eat here too.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的鳃，我在石头上翻滚。
lines.en: Fire reaches my gills, and I thrash across the stone.

lines.zh: 我从洞顶摔下，壳先着地，整条洞都响。
lines.en: I fall from the ceiling, shell first, and the whole tunnel rings.

lines.zh: 我在水里扑腾，螯足划得毫无章法。
lines.en: I flail in the water, my claws striking at nothing.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推进石缝，深板岩都在震。
lines.en: The blast shoves me into a crack, and the deepslate shakes.

lines.zh: 一支箭卡进我的甲缝，我扭身去够它。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my plate seam, and I twist to reach it.

lines.zh: 魔法的冷顺着壳缝爬进来，比洞穴更凉。
lines.en: Magic crawls through my shell seams, colder than the cave.

lines.zh: 洞里没有猎物，我的螯开始发抖。
lines.en: There is no prey in this cave, and my claws begin to shake.

lines.zh: 雷顺着矿洞传下来，我的壳嗡嗡作响。
lines.en: Thunder runs down the mine, and my shell hums.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，螯足抓不到任何东西。
lines.en: I fall into the void, and my claws catch nothing.
